items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Names are clear (flushChunk, ensureHeader, eofReached). But none of the exported APIs have doc comments (NewEncryptor, EncryptWriter, DecryptReader, LoadKey, Config.Validate). decryptReader.Read is a ~70-line loop with no comments on the frame format or the HMAC/sentinel handling.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Config, key loading and the stream code are in separate files, which is good. However, decryptReader.Read mixes framing, MAC, cipher setup and buffering in one function. aes.NewCipher/cipher.NewGCM are rebuilt for every chunk in both writer and reader, and the four mutually-exclusive branches in Config.Validate repeat the same pattern.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: init() sets `dr.initialized = true` before validating, so a second Read after an "invalid header" error carries on reading chunks; errors are not sticky. chunkLen has no upper bound, so `make([]byte, chunkLen)` lets crafted input force a huge allocation. On a flush error, Write returns a wrong byte count (`total - len(p) - toBuffer`).

items.name: Interface changes limited to the specified ones
items.name_zh: 接口变更仅限题目要求
items.evidence: The mandated changes are made and the storage tests were updated to the 3-arg PathGenerator; hidden tests pass. Extra change: Validate's receiver went from value `(job Job)` to pointer `(job *Job)`, and Encrypted was added on a pointer receiver, which changes the exported method set of Job values.
